meta_description: D&S Gardening Services is your trusted fence contractor in Leeds. Expert installation, repair, and maintenance. Free quotes available. Call today.
hero_subhead: From damaged panels to complete garden transformation, we deliver sturdy fences that last. Free survey and quote.
services_subhead: Whether you need a new fence, repairs, or a complete garden makeover, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Fence Installation
services.desc: New wooden, composite, or metal fences tailored to your garden. We handle site preparation, measurement, and installation to exacting standards.

services.title: Fence Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Rotting panels, loose posts, or wind damage? We assess damage and replace sections or entire runs quickly, often same week.

services.title: Garden Fencing Design
services.desc: Let us design a fence that complements your home and adds value. We advise on materials, heights, and styles to suit your budget.

services.title: Trellis & Screening
services.desc: Add privacy and beauty with custom trellis, screen panels, or slatted fencing. Perfect for hiding utilities or creating garden rooms.

services.title: Fence Maintenance & Treatment
services.desc: Annual pressure washing, staining, and treatment extends fence life by years. We protect against rot, weather, and UV damage.

services.title: Gate Installation & Repair
services.desc: Hanging new gates or fixing sagging hinges and latches. We work with timber, metal, and composite to match your fencing.

about_pullquote: A well-built fence should stand for decades, not years.
about_para_1: D&S Gardening was founded in 2013 on a simple idea: homeowners in Leeds deserve fences that are built properly and priced fairly. We've spent over a decade perfecting our craft, handling everything from suburban garden boundaries to large commercial perimeter work. Our reputation has grown through word-of-mouth and repeat customers who trust us to get the job right first time.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our attention to detail and genuine care for your property. We don't cut corners on post depth, concrete, or alignment—the foundations of a fence that lasts 20+ years. Most of our work comes from existing customers recommending us to neighbours, and we take that trust seriously. You'll work with experienced fencers who take time to understand your vision and deliver honest, competitive pricing.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About D&S Gardening

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Dave came round for a free quote, was honest about what we needed, and the lads got the new fence up in two days. Looks fantastic and they cleared all the old timber away. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Our old fence was falling apart after 15 years. Rather than replace the lot, D&S saved us money by repairing the worst panels and treating the rest. Still holding up well a year later. Great value and proper professional work.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Had a new composite fence put in and they made a really good job of it. The site was a nightmare—sloping garden, awkward access—but they sorted it without fuss. Fair price too. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Robert K.
